purpose: PERP-V1 arm A maker capacity check: is there resting depth to rest against
sql: select m.ticker, count(*) as snaps, round(avg(m.volume_24h)::numeric,0) as avg_vol24h, round(avg(m.open_interest_notional_usd)::numeric,0) as avg_oi_usd, round(avg(10000*(m.ask-m.bid)/nullif((m.ask+m.bid)/2,0))::numeric,1) as avg_spread_bps, round(avg(b.bid_depth)::numeric,2) as avg_bid_depth, round(avg(b.ask_depth)::numeric,2) as avg_ask_depth, round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by b.bid_depth)::numeric,2) as med_bid_depth from perp_market_snapshots m left join lateral (select o.bid_depth, o.ask_depth from perp_orderbook_snapshots o where o.ticker=m.ticker and o.captured_at between m.captured_at - interval '90 seconds' and m.captured_at + interval '90 seconds' order by abs(extract(epoch from (o.captured_at - m.captured_at))) limit 1) b on true where m.captured_at > now() - interval '72 hours' group by m.ticker order by avg_vol24h desc nulls last
